title: Stop Saying "I'm Angry": 3 Better Ways #shorts
description:
Another word for angry? When your roommate eats your lunch, you're not just angry. Here are 3 better ways to say it:
• Furious: extremely angry (everyday)
• Fuming: very angry, often quietly (everyday)
• Livid: even angrier than furious (neutral)

Would you shout, or say nothing?

Clip: The Battle of the Century (1927)

Find another word for any word on anotherwordfor.net
